ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

fsm_states_picc.name: POWER_OFF
fsm_states_picc.description: Card outside operating field; rectifier output below internal POR threshold; no internal state.

fsm_states_picc.name: IDLE
fsm_states_picc.description: Card powered (within field) but has not yet been polled. Listens for REQA / WUPA / REQB / WUPB. UID and configuration loaded from OTP.

fsm_states_picc.name: READY
fsm_states_picc.description: Card has answered REQA / WUPA with ATQA and is awaiting Anti-Collision / SELECT at Cascade Level 1.

fsm_states_picc.name: READY*
fsm_states_picc.description: Same as READY but reached from HALT (entered via WUPA, not REQA) — used for ordering and de-duplication during multi-card polling.

fsm_states_picc.name: ACTIVE
fsm_states_picc.description: Card has received the final SELECT for the final Cascade Level and replied with SAK. UID is fully published. Card may now receive Layer-3 application commands (MIFARE native protocol) or RATS.

fsm_states_picc.name: ACTIVE*
fsm_states_picc.description: Same as ACTIVE but reached via the HALT→WUPA path.

fsm_states_picc.name: T_CL_ACTIVE
fsm_states_picc.description: ISO 14443-4 Layer 4 activated after a successful RATS/ATS exchange. PICC accepts I-Block / R-Block / S-Block traffic and runs an alternating-block-number protocol.

fsm_states_picc.name: HALT
fsm_states_picc.description: Card has executed HLTA (or HLTB). Ignores REQA / REQB / SELECT. Only WUPA (or WUPB) can wake it from this state. Used by the PCD to remove an already-identified card from the polling loop during multi-PICC anti-collision.

fsm_transitions_major.description: Internal POR releases; OTP loads UID / ATQA / SAK / ATS templates.
PICC transmits ATQA; READY* path marks origin = HALT.
PICC keeps replying until NVB = 0x70 selects a single PICC.
Card returns S(DESELECT) and goes to HALT.
All state lost; CID, T=CL block number, FSCI all reset.
PICC replies R(NAK) and stays in T_CL_ACTIVE; PCD retransmits.

fsm_states_pcd.name: PCD_FIELD_ON
fsm_states_pcd.description: Carrier on; allow 5 ms guard time for PICC POR before first poll.

fsm_states_pcd.name: PCD_POLL_LOOP
fsm_states_pcd.description: Cyclically transmit REQA + REQB (or WUPA + WUPB).

fsm_states_pcd.name: PCD_ANTICOLLISION
fsm_states_pcd.description: Run Cascade Level loop on detected ATQA reply.

fsm_states_pcd.name: PCD_SELECTED
fsm_states_pcd.description: Single PICC selected; PCD owns its UID + SAK + (ATS if applicable).

fsm_states_pcd.name: PCD_T_CL_ACTIVE
fsm_states_pcd.description: PCD owns the T=CL channel; sends APDU-bearing I-Blocks.

fsm_states_pcd.name: PCD_HALT_AND_RESCAN
fsm_states_pcd.description: PCD has issued HLTA to currently selected PICC, returning to PCD_POLL_LOOP to discover any other PICCs.

fsm_hints.trigger: PCD always initiates; PICC never autonomously transmits. The PICC's transmit window is opened by a PCD-side carrier presence + decoded command + FDT delay.
fsm_hints.rule: After HALT, the PCD must use WUPA (not REQA) to re-engage the same PICC. Many readers use this to enumerate multiple PICCs in field by HALTing each one in turn.
fsm_hints.abort: PCD may always remove the field (carrier off) to forcibly reset all PICCs. PICCs detect carrier-off via their internal envelope detector falling below the POR threshold for > 1 ms (typical).

anti_deadlock_rule: Layer 4 (T=CL) uses 1-bit alternating block numbers per direction. After any timeout > FWT or any R(NAK), the PCD retransmits with the same block number; the PICC must respond. If the PICC requests more time it transmits S(WTX) with a multiplier ≤ 59; PCD shall extend FWT by that multiplier.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On internal POR (rising carrier envelope), PICC loads its OTP'd UID / ATQA / SAK templates, sets state = IDLE, sets all T=CL counters to 0, and starts listening for REQA / WUPA / REQB / WUPB.

default_ready_state_recommendation.carrier_idle: PCD carrier present but no modulation; PICC sees a continuous unmodulated 13.56 MHz envelope.
default_ready_state_recommendation.antenna_loading: PCD antenna sees only the linear (constant) load of the PICC's rectifier when PICC is in IDLE/HALT — no subcarrier energy.

configurations.name: Type A only
configurations.description: PCD only polls REQA; PICC family is Type A (MIFARE Classic, Plus, DESFire, Ultralight, NTAG).

configurations.name: Type A + Type B
configurations.description: PCD alternates REQA and REQB polls — required for PICCs that support both (e.g. e-passports, JCOP).

configurations.name: Layer-3-only PICC
configurations.description: SAK bit 6 = 0; PCD never issues RATS; application protocol is MIFARE native or NFC Forum Type 2 above Layer 3.

configurations.name: Layer-4 (T=CL) PICC
configurations.description: SAK bit 6 = 1; PCD issues RATS → ATS → optionally PPS → I-Blocks carrying APDU (DESFire / SmartMX / JCOP / Type-4 tag).

configurations.name: Random ID (RID) mode
configurations.description: PICC reports UID0 = 0x08, UID1..UID3 randomised per POR — privacy-preserving variant (MIFARE DESFire EV2/EV3 / NFC-A peer).

timing_dependency_rule: All PCD-PICC timing is referenced to the 13.56 MHz carrier (fc). The Elementary Time Unit (ETU) at 106 kbps is 128/fc ≈ 9.44 μs. The PICC must answer REQA within fdt_listen ≤ 1172/fc ≈ 86.43 μs from the end of the PCD command; the PCD must wait fdt_poll ≥ 1172/fc before resuming polling. T=CL uses FWT = (256 × 16 / fc) × 2^FWI (FWI ∈ {0..14}); default FWI = 4 gives FWT ≈ 4.8 ms.
